messages:
sachin: Heads-up: CI eval-runner is failing on the prefetch + batch step. Getting S3 413 on artifact PUTs, seems correlated with a spike in per-sample KV duplication.
ci-bot: build #1284 | eval-runner: artifact_upload error 413 PayloadTooLarge
maria: I saw similar locally when running quantized model tests. Prefetcher is re-requesting same kv keys per-shard; duplicates cause payload blowup.
olivia: logs? can we get the runner debug dump for the failing shard?
sachin: pasted small section:
```
[runner] shard=7 prefetch: keys=452 -> unique=37 total_bytes=12.3MB
s3.put_object error: 413 Request Entity Too Large
```
ben: maybe dedupe isn't applied before chunking. Quick hack: compress + chunk after dedup.
devin: CI is currently set to max artifact size 10MB; we should either chunk earlier or increase limit, but increasing is bandaid.
maria: patch candidate: move KV dedupe into PrefetchManager.prefetch() before build_payload(). small diff:
```
- payload = build_payload(kv_list)
+ kv_list = dedupe(kv_list)
+ payload = build_payload(kv_list)
```
olivia: also add sampling flag for CI: `--sample-limit=100` to avoid huge runs during PRs
sachin: can someone run a quick repro with `eng-ml-ci/runner --branch=kv-prefetch-fix --limit=60` ?
ben: running now, will report back
ci-bot: started job 1285
ben: job finished, artifacts uploaded OK, no 413s. looks promising :thumbsup: 
sachin: opened issue https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-489 to track follow-ups (metrics to detect duplication, dashboard alert). Thanks all.
olivia: I'll add a grafana alert for artifact size tail > 8MB
maria: will send a PR with the dedupe patch + unit test
devin: once PR is up, let's add CI gate to fail on artifact size regression
sachin: good plan, moving to in-progress. :tada:
